NO. SEC/BD/SE/  
 
 
 
May 19, 2026 
 
 
Dear Sir / Madam,  
 
Sub.: Audio Recording of Investors Meet / Analysts ConCall held on Tuesday, 
May 19, 2026 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 
We have vide our letter dated May 14, 2026 intimated the Stock Exchanges about the 
schedule of Investors / Analysts Meet through Conference Call scheduled on Tuesday, 
May 19, 2026 at 4:00 PM (IST). 
 
We send herewith a Link:  
https://www.gnfc.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/10043451.mp3 
 
of Audio Recording of above referred Investors Meet / Analysts ConCall. 
 
The said digital Transcript is uploaded on the Company's Website — www.gnfc.in 
 
We request you to kindly take note of the above.  
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited
